title: 60 #### 3.4 Persons Arrested under Local & Special Laws A total of 27,43,321 persons were booked during 1974 for committing various offences under the Local & Special Laws against 25,80,140 during 1973. The highest number of persons booked were under the offence 'Motor Vehicle Act', and the percentage being 23·0 per cent to total. The other offences accounted for 12·3 per cent under the Gambling Act, and 11·6 per cent under the Prohibition Act. The pattern of arrests under different offences was more or less the same as was recorded during 1973. The relevant statistics are presented in Table 23 and 24.
